title: Magenta Velvet Floral Embroidered Suit
descriptionHtml:
A magenta velvet suit with floral embroidery framing the V-neckline, front and cuffs. The shorter top is styled with matching tapered trousers for a richly detailed festive look.

Design details

  • Color: Magenta
  • Fabric: Velvet
  • Detail: Floral embroidery, V-neckline and wide embroidered cuffs
  • Occasion: Festive
